title: Hi! I’m Anne,
lead: I’m an illustrator, character designer, and game designer interested in the funny, tender, and slightly odd.
caption: That’s me!
bio: My work starts with a pencil, a pile of references, and the question “what if it had a tiny hat?” Edit this paragraph with your own story.
I love collaborating with kind people on fashion concepts, indie games, and identity projects. When I’m not drawing, you’ll find me playing with my dog.
I'm a freelance illustrator based in NYC open to Contract, commission, freelance and permeant work in 2d character design, concept art and game  art.
